handback.t:
R9-B (h18) is done, all synthetic-until-validated. The domain tools and independent verifiers work, but extraction from word problems limits the lift. Nothing was committed, `src/tools.rs` is untouched, and `src/lib.rs` gained only `pub mod fin;`.

**What was built**
- **Tools:** `src/fin.rs` has three tools, `FinTool` (37 ops), `SciTool` (21 ops) and `EconTool` (4 ops), all implementing `tools::Tool`.
  - Finance and business: NPV, IRR (bracketed bisection, tolerance 1e-13, reports iterations and convergence), payback, compounding, annuity, loan/amortisation, bond price/yield/duration, CAGR, WACC, ratios, break-even, option payoff, put-call parity, perpetuities.
  - Science: compound-unit conversion with dimension checks, significant figures, error propagation, statistics and regression, stoichiometry, ideal gas, kinematics.
  - Economics: elasticity, real vs nominal, inflation, Fisher.
  - All numbers are f64 with a documented 1e-6 answer tolerance. Loops are bounded and overflow/NaN are guarded.
- **Verifiers:** every op has an independent verifier that shares no evaluator code with the tool. Examples are NPV(IRR)=0 as a sign-change check, amortisation sums to principal, duration against a numeric derivative of price, and unit round trips through an exact rational table.
- **Unit tests:** `cargo test --release --offline --lib fin` gives 21 passed; 16 of them are in the `fin` module.
- **Selfcheck:** over 7,440 clean outputs and 62 ops there were 0 false rejects, and all 36,914 wrong claims were rejected. 150,000 garbage or extreme-value calls caused no panic and no non-finite output.
- **Real bug found:** the verifier caught `sfround x=50.429 n=2` returning "50", which hides that the zero is significant. I fixed it to "5.0e1" and added a regression test.

**Mutation testing (44 seeded bugs, 41 independent + 3 common-mode)**

| | Share of silent-wrong outputs caught |
|---|---|
| Shared verifier (re-runs the same evaluator) | 0.0% |
| Independent verifier | 89.9% overall |
| Independent verifier, excluding the 3 common-mode bugs | 100% |

- Results are the same on tune, held and confirm seeds, with 0 false rejects on either side.
- The shared verifier's 0% is by construction, so this is not comparable with g21's 19%.
- The 3 common-mode bugs (same wrong constant planted in both paths) are caught 0% by both.

**Extraction from word problems** (held 31-60; confirm is within about 1.5 points)

| | Seen phrasing | Unseen phrasing |
|---|---|---|
| World A | 96.8% right | 39.4% right |
| World B | 94.3% right | 33.7% right |

- The extractor's cue words come from the seen phrase bank, so the seen rate is not a generalisation estimate. The unseen bank is one I wrote.
- Confidence is usable: at conf ≥ 0.9 the spec is 99.7–99.9% right.
- On no-math prose the extractor emits a spec 13–15% of the time.

**Correctness lift vs best fair plain baseline** (held A / B; confirm +0.044 / +0.037 for H, 30/0/0 and 29/1/0, max Holm p ≤ 6e-10)

| Arm | Held A | Held B | Cost vs plain |
|---|---|---|---|
| H, pre-declared headline (extractor spec → learned tool selection → independent verifier) | +0.042 | +0.043 | 1.3x |
| R: use the tool only if extractor confidence ≥ 0.7 | +0.076 | +0.081 | 1.2x |
| S: confidence tiers (post-hoc) | +0.085 | +0.087 | 1.3x |
| V-only: verify the model's own answer against the extracted spec | +0.062 | +0.060 | 1.4–1.5x |
| T: always call the tool on the extracted spec | +0.002 (n.s.) | −0.046 | 1.1x |
| XC: given the clean canonical spec (ceiling) | +0.132 | +0.162 | 1.1x |

- **Offload:** the potential is real, but extraction errors cost −0.13 / −0.21 and cancel it for always-tool use.
- **Verification:** checking tool output on a correct evaluator adds +0.0003. It pays against buggy evaluators: with a bug deployed, the independent verifier beats the shared one by +0.1 to +2.3 points end to end (bug-injected run, held A/B), and +0.0003 against common-mode bugs. Checking the model's own answer (V-only) is worth about +0.06.
- **Learned selection:** the one-parameter rule R beats the learned selector H by about 0.035 on every held and confirm set, as in g21.
- **Post-hoc:** S and the verifier-fit weight in the selector reward were designed on tune seeds 1-8 after seeing H, and are flagged in the entry; nothing was tuned on the unseen bank. S matches or slightly beats a 3-model vote (cost 30) at about 43% of its cost.
- **Where the lift comes from:** problems with 7 or more steps (+0.13 to +0.15), finance and science. It is zero for problems with 3 steps or fewer, and about zero for business ratios.
- **Where it vanishes:** H is negative on unseen phrasing and at an all-unseen text share; with an easy model and all-unseen text every tool arm is slightly negative.
- **Controls:** on all-prose worlds, H and R pass TOST ±0.01 in all four held/confirm cells. R's difference is exactly 0, and the cost is +0.3 to +0.45 per task. Ungated tool use loses 0.11–0.13 correctness and fails TOST.
- **Error-scale sweep:** H's lift is −0.005 at error ×0.25 and +0.16 at ×3, so everything depends on my assumed plain-model error rate.

**Disclosures**
- Worlds A and B differ in structure but share the same op bank and phrase templates.
- The plain-model error curve (error rises with difficulty and step count) is my assumption, with its sweep as above.
- The extractor lexicon comes from the seen bank only.
- Cost is nominal units, not tokens.
- There is no real LLM, text or traffic.
